difficulty_reason: Detecting D^-_QCoh from a perfect generator: proves the equivalences (1)-(7) - (1)=>(2) by the Ext band lemma; (2)-(4) equivalent via the global RHom discussion, (5)-(6) by definition, and the bridge by the dual perfect complex with (G[-i])^vee = G^vee[i]; (7)=>(2) clear; (2)-(6)=>(7) by the classical-generator check (T inherited by sums, 2-out-of-3, summands, shifts, plus the P -> P^vee self-equivalence - small detail omitted, noted); (2)-(7)=>(1) by the induction principle: affine case from the schemes proposition, distinguished-square step with the Koszul K' generator, j_! Hom vanishing, the orthogonal-Koszul first variant giving tau_{>=a}(E|_V) = tau_{>=a}R(U×_X V -> V)_*, the restriction check for tau_{>=a}E = tau_{>=a}R(U -> X)_*E|_U, and the bounded-truncation twice + generator induction on U.
